file_roles.evidence: 'new GenericJBossMarshaller()' replaced by new GenericJBossMarshaller(classLoader); the old default used the commons module classloader that cannot see deployed Pojos.
super(new GenericJBossMarshaller()) replaced by a constructor taking a ClassLoader; same wrong-classloader marshaller creation.
lookupEncoder now receives gcr.classLoader() and calls new CompatModeEncoder(compatMarshaller, classLoader) instead of the default-classloader encoder.
Registers new GenericJbossMarshallerEncoder(classLoader) and new CompatModeEncoder(globalMarshaller, classLoader) using globalConfiguration.classLoader(), replacing the static INSTANCE.

rationale: The Pojo bytes are deserialized by a GenericJBossMarshaller built with the commons module classloader, so deployed classes are not found. All four files change where that marshaller is created or which classloader is handed to it, so I marked each causal. The two commons changes only add a constructor, so they are close to enabling API, which makes the split with the core wiring uncertain. The marshaller class is cited from the report text, not from the diff.
